description_en: Returns the download URL of artifacts by job name and an optional run ID after a run completes. If JobRunId is not specified, the results of the most recent run of the job are returned
description_zh: 在运行结束后，按任务名称和可选运行标识返回产物下载地址；不传 JobRunId 时返回该任务最新一次运行的结果
name: DownloadSemanticResults

parameters.help_en: The job name. You can obtain this value from Data.Name in the CreateSemanticJob response, Name in the ListSemanticJobs response, or JobName in the ListSemanticJobRuns response
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称，使用 CreateSemanticJob 响应的 Data.Name、ListSemanticJobs 列表项的 Name，或 ListSemanticJobRuns 记录中的 JobName
parameters.name: job_name

parameters.help_en: The optional run ID. If you specify the JobRunId from the RunSemanticJob response (Data.JobRunId) or the ListSemanticJobRuns response, only the artifacts of the specified run are returned. If you do not specify this parameter, the artifacts of the most recent run of the job are returned
parameters.help_zh: 可选的运行标识。填入 RunSemanticJob 响应的 Data.JobRunId 或 ListSemanticJobRuns 记录中的 JobRunId 时，仅返回该次运行的产物；不填则返回该任务最新一次运行的产物
parameters.name: job_run_id

schema.description_en: The standard response for retrieving download URLs of run artifacts. Each item in Data.Results corresponds to a result file
schema.description_zh: 获取运行产物下载地址的标准响应。Data.Results 中每项对应一个结果文件

Data.description_en: The collection of result files for the specified job run. Multiple items are returned if a single run generates multiple files
Data.description_zh: 指定任务运行的结果文件集合；同一次运行生成多个文件时会返回多项

Results.description_en: The list of result files. Each item contains the associated job name, run ID, and a short-lived download URL
Results.description_zh: 结果文件列表。每项携带所属任务、所属运行和一个短时有效的下载地址

items.description_en: A result file generated by a semantic job run
items.description_zh: 一个由语义任务运行生成的结果文件

DownloadUrl.description_en: The temporary pre-signed download URL of the result file. Download the file promptly by using an HTTP GET request. Do not log, share, or treat the full URL as a long-term address
DownloadUrl.description_zh: 结果文件的临时预签名下载地址。请尽快通过 HTTP GET 下载，且不要记录、传播完整 URL 或将其视为长期地址

JobName.description_en: The job name to which the artifact belongs. This value is the same as the JobName in the request
JobName.description_zh: 产物所属任务名称，与请求的 JobName 一致

JobRunId.description_en: The run ID to which the artifact belongs. You can compare this value with Data.JobRunId in the RunSemanticJob response or JobRunId in the ListSemanticJobRuns response
JobRunId.description_zh: 产物所属运行标识；可与 RunSemanticJob 的 Data.JobRunId 或 ListSemanticJobRuns 的 JobRunId 对照

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志和排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
